title: Reusable parametric components, materials, and model coordination on the verified CAD/BIM product
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product beyond one-off BIM elements into reusable parametric building components and model-coordination primitives while preserving the frozen CADDocument/App API/Construction Graph architecture: family/component definitions produce typed instances with stable canonical identities and instance-to-definition provenance; materials exist as canonical domain data independent of OCCT/IfcOpenShell internals; grids and reference planes are canonical coordination elements (levels already exist as bim.story); definition edits propagate deterministically to instances and create immutable revisions; component/material semantics round-trip through the production IFC adapter with explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED reporting; Construction Graph mappings stay keyed by canonical component/instance identities; Web/Electron produce equivalent semantic results through the shared App API.
acceptance_criteria: A representative component definition can produce multiple instances with stable canonical definition/instance relationships.
Definition edits propagate deterministically to affected instances and create immutable revisions.
Materials are represented canonically with stable identity and provenance independent of OCCT/IfcOpenShell internals.
Grid/level/reference-plane data persists and survives save/open and replay.
Web and Electron produce equivalent semantic component/model-coordination results.
IFC export/import preserves supported component/material semantics or reports explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes.
Construction Graph mapping remains independent of engine-native IDs.
Existing drafting, BIM, documentation, IFC, real-engine and governance suites remain green.
No protected architecture files are modified.
non_goals: Full constraint solver implementation (alignment constraints outside the supported set are reported explicitly as unsupported).
Project/scheduling work (explicitly deferred by the Architect).
Approval or verification claim by implementation.
risk_assumptions: Issue #50 (scope) + Issue #51 (execution directive) + execution release comment 5440204020 are authoritative.
Component/material/coordination scope is carried by existing requirement IDs BIM-001/BIM-002/IFC-001; no new requirement IDs were added to spec/requirements.md (spec stays frozen).
COMPAT-CAD-001 remains a pre-existing architect-side governance close-out debt on main; it is not a dependency of this slice.

Parametric propagation is designed as derivation-from-definition (instances store placement plus explicit parameter overrides; effective parameters are computed deterministically) so no stale copy can drift; definition edits are themselves immutable revisions and instance impact is queryable.

IFC round-trip covers component instances (mapped per category to IfcDoor/IfcWindow/IfcWall/IfcFurnishingElement with identity psets) and materials (IfcMaterial + IfcRelAssociatesMaterial); grids/reference planes are coordination-only canonical data with explicit UNSUPPORTED classification in IFC exchange.
Toolchain pins follow the verified COMPAT-IFC-001 setup: cadquery-ocp==7.8.1.1.post1, ifcopenshell==0.8.5, IfcTester==0.8.5, numpy==2.1.3; known broken PyPI mirrors stay excluded.

evidence.description: 338/338 app tests on the real toolchains locally (OCCT 7.8.1.1 + ifcopenshell 0.8.5 + IfcTester 0.8.5) at the implementation head: 312 pre-existing CAD/drafting/BIM/documentation/IFC regressions + 26 new deterministic component tests (13 strict-constructor matrices incl. effective-parameter derivation definition⊕overrides + per-category box invariants + propagation invariants; 13 workflow tests: definition→instance relationships with stable canonical ids and provenance, typed rejects (unknown definition references, duplicate material names, foreign overrides, constraint ops outside the supported set), propagation creating immutable revisions with deterministic instance impact + atomic undo restoring both, whitelisted instance edits re-validated against the definition schema, material canonical identity/provenance + reference integrity, grid/reference-plane persistence through save/open and verified replay, Construction Graph mappings keyed by canonical ids with engine ids never participating, IFC export determinism with exact component/material counts + explicit grid/reference-plane non-export, fresh-document round trip incl. definition defaults reconstructed from NON-OVERRIDING instances (regression-locked: def-desk 1600, desk1 effective 1600 override-free, desk2 pinned 1200), same-document identity-based reconciliation, controlled-mutation identification of exactly the mutated elements, zero-loss ifc.compare, external furnishing importing with declared fallbacks). LOCK-018 forbidden-import scan covers src/bim incl. the component core. Toolchain-absent environments skip the IFC tests with recorded reasons.

Deployable host proofs on the implementation head: Web lint/typecheck/build clean + the exact CI components workflow smoke verified locally end-to-end against the running dev server on the real toolchain (seed 13 entities in one atomic versioned batch; derived inventory exact — desk1 1600 override-free, desk2 1200 pinned, wall inherits the definition default material, door carries an instance material, unsupported set declared; definition-edit propagation deterministic 1600→1800 with the override pinned; atomic undo restored the derived state; deterministic export sha256 87d8e5d88f975aff…/12201 bytes with materials 2, components 5, grids/reference planes declared NOT exported; fresh-document import preserving semantics with definition defaults from the NON-OVERRIDING instance; zero-loss compare unchanged 8/lossy 0/unsupported fields 0). Electron typecheck/build clean + smoke:components 5/5 PASS (mode toggle + seed → derived state → propagation with pinned override → atomic undo → IFC round trip with zero-loss compare) + all eight regression smokes green (smoke, geometry on the real OCCT engine, model, impact, drafting, bim, docs, ifc 12/12). Web/Electron parity: byte-identical export sha on both hosts through the shared App API.

evidence_requirements: Deterministic component-definition/instance tests: multiple instances from one definition with stable canonical identities and definition provenance; strict LOCK-007 validation.
Propagation evidence: definition edits change instance effective parameters deterministically, create immutable revisions, and undo restores both; instance overrides survive propagation.
Materials evidence: canonical identity/provenance independent of engines; reference integrity (no dangling material references).
Coordination evidence: grids/reference planes persist through save/open and replay.

IFC round-trip evidence through the production adapter: component/material semantics preserved or explicitly classified LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED in the reconciliation report; identity psets preserve canonical ids; engine GlobalIds stay provenance-only.
Construction Graph evidence: component/instance/material/coordination elements project on canonical ids, independent of engine ids (LOCK-019).
Web/Electron parity through the shared App API and real transports.
Existing CAD, drafting, BIM, documentation, IFC, real-engine and governance suites remain green; LOCK-018 boundary holds for any engine code.
CI reproduces the component/material/coordination suite on the pinned toolchains with regressions green.
